relationships.subject: ALKBH5
relationships.evidence_quote: Lin et al. found that increased expression of m6A demethylase ALKBH5 upregulates the expression of EZH2 and H3K27Me3 in the hypoxic microenvironment of endometriosis

relationships.subject: METTL14
relationships.evidence_quote: Our results demonstrate that METTL14 polymorphisms are associated with susceptibility to ovarian endometriosis among Chinese women.

key_findings: METTL14 rs298982 A allele associated with increased and rs62328061 G allele with decreased risk of ovarian endometriosis in a Chinese cohort.
eQTL analysis linked variant genotypes to altered METTL14 mRNA levels.
